Most of what's been happening over the past 24h on X the Everything Site is partisans engaging, consciously or not, in frenzied information warfare to control a narrative. This can bear a superficial resemblance to "discourse" or "truth-seeking" but I think to veterans--especially those who remember the before-times--the difference will be obvious.

For those of you who are deliberately enjoying this war, by all means have fun storming the castle. I can only ask that you leave me out of the exercise, although this being a war I don't actually expect to be left alone.

For people who find themselves swept up in strong opinions about a contentious and politically-laden incident before the body is even cool, but don't actually want to live as an egregore's appendage: occasional reminder that you don't have to.

Your body is secure on the Internet, but your mind and your soul are very much exposed. Stay safe out there.
